collection.title: Chrysler 300C Saloon 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chrysler 300C Saloon 2004 to 2010 requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
